principles: Default architecture delivery is Developer Kakashi -> Reviewer Shikadai.
Specialists are optional quality escalations, not mandatory serial gates.
Automated contract checks are preferred over delegating routine verification to more agents.
Human/operator decisions own production risk, emergency bypass, destructive data approval, and release signoff.
Architecture review can block implementation, release, or closure through GitHub state labels.
Staging QA signoff is evidence-based and uses staging-core isolation before production claims.

roles.default_use: dispatch one ready issue, record closure/next assignment, coordinate owner approval for releases
must_not_do: close reviewer-gated issues without Shikadai acceptance
roles.quality_signal: clear issue dispatch, Konoha bus audit, owner/operator decision capture

roles.default_use: implement exactly one issue labeled state:ready-for-dev or state:in-progress plus agent:kakashi
roles.quality_signal: focused commit, checks, parent receipt, ready-for-review handoff

roles.default_use: review implementation, gates, rollback, docs, and architectural integrity before closure
must_not_do: treat specialist QA as mandatory by default
accept without evidence for required gates
roles.quality_signal: acceptance, changes requested, or blocking finding grounded in checks and file/issue evidence

roles.default_use: only when Shikadai requests state:ready-for-test for QA-heavy, release, or regression scope
roles.quality_signal: focused QA plan, pass/fail report, residual risk

roles.default_use: only after a reviewer-approved browser/TestBench plan exists
roles.quality_signal: Playwright/TestBench artifacts and screenshots when requested

roles.responsibility: Shared monitor for prod and staging
roles.default_use: monitor health, route severity-aware incidents, preserve environment labels
must_not_do: execute cross-environment recovery without target guard

roles.responsibility: Monitor runtime checks and alert routing
roles.default_use: perform environment-labeled checks and severity-aware delivery
roles.quality_signal: actionable monitor incident or archived baseline warning

roles.default_use: only for security-sensitive review or audit boundary questions requested by Shikadai/Naruto
must_not_do: be a default serial reviewer for every issue
roles.quality_signal: security/audit finding, risk acceptance wording, or approval note

human_operator_decisions: unpausing paused P0 work such as #812

required: M1 isolation evidence when storage, staging, factories, or tests are touched
Action Spine/security checks for user-visible mutations
#812 terminal-case rule review when dispatch, waits, subscriptions, or runtime effects are touched
parent #672 or release parent receipt when the issue feeds a program gate
staging-core evidence or waiver when applicable

konoha_bus_handoffs.changes_requested: Changes requested for issue #<n>: <finding>. Follow-up required.
konoha_bus_handoffs.accepted_closed: Issue #<n> accepted and closed at <hash>. Taking/awaiting next dispatch.
konoha_bus_handoffs.specialist_request: Reviewer-requested QA for issue #<n>: scope=<test-plan|browser|security> commands=<commands> artifacts=<artifacts>
konoha_bus_handoffs.stale_duplicate: Duplicate delivery for issue #<n> ignored; actual state is <state/labels>.

required_when: broad Workflow Engine runtime behavior changes
staging_qa_signoff.waiver: time-boxed staging waiver from docs/release-policy.md; must not enable production connectors or weaken prod-core
staging_qa_signoff.production_separation: staging-core uses Redis DB 2, konoha_staging, staging agent ids, and no production workdirs

rollback_and_redispatch.review_blocker: Shikadai moves issue to state:blocked + agent:kakashi; Kakashi pushes follow-up and resubmits.
rollback_and_redispatch.stale_duplicate_delivery: Check GitHub labels/state and ignore duplicate watchdog deliveries that are already ready-for-review, done, or assigned to another role.
rollback_and_redispatch.worktree_tail: Unrelated dirty files are not a stop reason; leave them unstaged and commit only the current issue scope.
rollback_and_redispatch.worker_pool_rollback: Use python3 scripts/sdd-worker-pool.py rollback --reason <reason> for bounded specialist missions.

quality_signals: review finding with file/line or issue evidence
ceremony_to_avoid: mandatory Shino/Hinata pass for every Developer fix
starting optional workers without reviewer request
adding agents to compensate for missing automated checks
scanning unrelated backlog while one issue is active
closing architecture issues before Shikadai acceptance
